title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am working in a Maharashtra state government office where giving bribes( Rishwat) is not a new thing. But I do not accept it. Annually I pay @ ( 20%of my annual income)Rs.35000 as Income Tax and approximately Rs.25,000 as Zakat. This total sum is a bit big amount for me. My question is Can I ask the person giving me bribe to pay my Income Tax as I think income tax taken from us is unislamic. It is taken deliberately from us. As in some Islamic countries like Saudi your income is totally tax free. If there is a jawaz for it it will reduce the burden on me 2588 views Q. today most wines are made from fruits, vegetables, wheat, barley etc. for examples Whiskey, Rum, Black Label, Blue Label, Vodka etc. these all wines are permitted by Abu Hanifa to drink upto a level until one is intoxicated (see Hidaya where abu hanifa only regard dates and grapes wines as haram). I am easily take three glasses of these wines and i am never intoxicated. as i m a hanafi is this halal for me for take the wines made other than grapes and dates (almost all commercial wines are from fruits now days). 2) i am born in USA and as per Hidaya, Hanafi can take riba from any kafir in dar al Harb. USA is an open enemy of Muslims and has declared open wars in many muslim countries. as a hanafi i gave loans to non-muslims here in USA and i take heavy interest on them. Is this halal for me as a hanafi ? 6604 views Q. I have 2 questions 1) can a married person can use condom just to avoid chil for some years? 2)is it is allow to look or touch each other geniticles during intercoarse? 3422 views Q. My question is regarding intrest on investment i just want to know that my organization in which i m working is running different business for the welfare of its own employee it also gives an option to invest its employees money in the business and in june and december each year they review the progress and analyze their profit or loss n then they distribute the profit to all stake holders at the analyzed profit rates in %.my organization doesnt give loan to individuals or banks means all ur money is put directly in to business there is no penalty on withdrwing money at any time n there is no pre fixed profit rates means profit rates keep on variating as audited is this investment HALAL or HARAM 1378 views Q. I want to read Homeopathic. According to Shariah whether it is lawful or wrong. 2072 views Q. I know that it is haram to take photographs or to videotape of humans and animals. But, Arab TV channels broadcasts live five-time salawat and as well as the Tarawih salat from Makkah. According to me, it is not permissible or halal. But I would like to hear the fatwa in this regard please. Please answer as soon as possible. 4436 views Q. I was an employee of a BPO company. Three months back I left the company. Now I'm going to take the PF amount(Provident Fund). PF amount is halal or haram? Can I use this amount to do the business? If it is haram what can I do with this amount? Can I give this to my parents? or Can I give this money to my friend from which I have borrowed the money? 2037 views Q. My job's salary is halal or not 5677 views Q. One of my brothers is a driver in Dubai he want to ask whether is it halal to break traffic line at border of Dubai and Saudi Arab 1669 views Q. My husband does not allow me to shave my pubic hair. Will it affect my prayers? 5781 views Q. Working with a e commerce company which promotes food and beverages for merchants and takes commission, my salary is halal? 2033 views Q. I am working with two employers (one full time and one part time). 3195 views Q. I am working in a Multinational company and there are various options to save the TAX. As per my understanding muslims are not supposed to pay any tax but since we are living in India and goverment impose us to pay tax so we pay them. There are various schemes available to save the TAX one of them is HOME LOAN. If i buy a Home with taking loan from bank then i gets rebate of 1.5 Lac of Income tax, the same amount 1.5 lac i can contribute to any poor peoples or charity if its saved. Is it allowed in our shariah to avail such benefits. Others are Life insurance, Mediclaim etc, Just for the sake of saving TAX and i don't have any intention to use the interest portion which i would recieve from policy. Jazaakumullah. 2563 views Q. My question is that some hunters in our area bring pigeon and partridges (titar) to sell and they do zibah not in front of us 3855 views Q. Ques1: Is it permissible to run a recruitment agency (placement service) wherein you help companies to interview and hire employees provided the company is not involved in a haraam business e.g a company which manufactures 'plastic chairs'? Ques2: Will it will be permissible if some part of the job of the employee (that we help to recruit) is haraam like calculation and recording of interest assuming we recruit accounting professionals and no company nowadays is free of interest ? 4278 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 65221 Country: Bagladesh Title: Watching Photo in Newspapers!!!! Question: As we know taking (human or animals) photo and creating video is haram. But is it permissible to watch photo in newspaper or internet? Answer ID: 65221 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 864/870/=08/1437) It is not lawful to watch illegal photos in newspapers or internet such as women, beardless boys or pictures with satr uncovered. There is no sin in watching the other photos. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
